set.body: tidy(fit, type='estimates') and type='contrasts' both fail with 'Unexpected structure in nested statistics table' (R/fmri_lm_methods.R:172 .tidy_stat_block) for a basic fmri_lm(onset ~ hrf(condition), block=~run, dataset=matrix_dataset, strategy='runwise'). coef()/stats()/standard_error() all work on the same fit. Discovered while building reduce_betas/reduce_contrasts (M2); reducers were rebuilt on coef()/standard_error() to avoid the broken path. Worth a focused fix to tidy.fmri_lm.
set.title: Bug: tidy.fmri_lm errors on simple runwise matrix_dataset fit
